adjudication.rationale: The diff changes Calendar.createEvent to accept a required `credentialId` (packages/types/Calendar.d.ts) and EventManager now loops over `event.destinationCalendar[]` for collective hosts (packages/core/EventManager.ts `createAllCalendarEvents`). CalendarManager then calls `calendar.createEvent(calEvent, credential.id)` for every credential (packages/core/CalendarManager.ts). GoogleCalendarService uses that `credentialId` to select the matching destination calendar entry (`find(cal => cal.credentialId === credentialId)`), but Office365CalendarService and LarkCalendarService (and BaseCalendarService filtering) now destructure only the first destination calendar (`const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event.destinationCalendar ?? []`) and use its `externalId`, ignoring which destination/credential is currently being processed. Because EventManager passes the same `event` containing all destination calendars into each per-destination create call, non-Google providers will always target destinationCalendar[0] even when invoked for other hosts’ credentials, plausibly causing 404/no-access and failing to write to the intended host calendar.
